_comment: Spirit Tree Atlas destination dataset, reconciled 2026-10-04 from the cache (2727, 2026-09-30), the OSRS Wiki, Shortest Path and the menu research. See RECONCILE.md for every disagreement and its resolution. Tiles are [x, y, plane]; tree.sw is the loc placement (south-west tile), tree.center the footprint centre. Unlock conditions follow Fairy Ring Atlas tools/data/unlock.json (quest/varbit/varp/unknown; low confidence only as unknown). Centres (tree.center, housePortals[].center) are exact footprint centres in tile-index units: the south-west tile plus (size-1)/2. Printable ASCII only. The seven fixes of the 2026-10-04 data challenge are applied (listed in _fixes and tools/data/README.md).
_fixes: FARMING_GUILD.requirements: 85 Farming to plant (advanced tier), was 83
housePortals 9 (Prifddinas) and 13 (Aldarin): valueConfidence high, from cache enum 252
HOSIDIUS.area: next to the saltpetre, south-east of the Forthos Ruin (not just south of the Forthos Dungeon)
BATTLEFIELD_OF_KHAZARD.poi: Clock Tower to the south-east (was east)
ETCETERIA.notes: the only teleport onto the island (Sailing can moor there); requirement line for The Fremennik Trials added
housePortals[].center: exact footprint centres (were rounded down)
previousDestination.source: the op text is on 9 locs, adding 40778 and 44936

menu.title: Spirit Tree Locations
menu.match: Strip tags from each row (Text.removeTags), drop the "K: " prefix, then match menuLabel (exact, or prefix for Your house). Prefer labels over keys: the keys have been 1-E in every capture, but an account missing a destination has not been captured.
